title: Specialized Roubaix SL8 Expert review
notes: Independent review of a Roubaix SL8 Expert reports a plush Future Shock front and a stiffer-feeling rear, describing the ride as potentially unbalanced on smooth roads. This is meaningful qualitative operating evidence for the Roubaix SL8 platform, not a numeric frame test and not proof that every component-level Tiagra build feels identical.
